status: accepted for finite unattended continuation under declared operational bounds

findings_and_fixes.finding: Per-condition requested denominator excluded process failures/in-flight requests
findings_and_fixes.resolution: Count every request receipt; distinguish completed, valid, invalid, process-failed and in-flight/uncheckpointed.

findings_and_fixes.finding: Partial failed-process CSV evidence omitted from export
findings_and_fixes.resolution: Archive partial job directories and export file hashes separately; never promote unverified partial outputs into valid-fit summaries.

findings_and_fixes.finding: Supervisor timeout could orphan R descendants
findings_and_fixes.resolution: New process session per runner; TERM process group, bounded grace, unconditional KILL attempt for surviving descendants, then reap leader.

findings_and_fixes.finding: Target selector trusted completed state without final integrity audit
findings_and_fixes.resolution: Check checkpoint identity during selection; target-reached path validates every complete checkpoint and performs hash-verified export.
Reject batch-jobs>480; CLI bounds tests also reject hours>12 and batches>110.

findings_and_fixes.finding: Final audit/reporting could overrun continuation deadline
findings_and_fixes.resolution: Deadline checked per final-audit job; reporting subprocess timeout bounded by remaining allowance and600seconds.

operational_review: At most110 runner invocations and12hours; each runner uses at most480datasets,4workers,12dataset chunks and1800seconds. Runner independently enforces CPU quota,1thread per worker, namespace lock and memory threshold.

Supervisor dispatch examines completed identities, states and fixed target membership only, never estimates, uncertainty intervals or significance. Invalid completed fits do not trigger favorable-selection retries.
Baseline0-19 is a guarded audit, not additional unique datasets; new20-999 is counted separately.
Fixed process/code/memory/time limits can stop continuation with unfinished target; no claim these stopping rules establish scientific completion.
Snapshot checkpoint paths before request scan avoids common concurrent-report negative-inflight race; reporting remains an interim snapshot.
limits: Failure and process-group behavior were reviewed in code; no live forced-timeout production job was injected. Reporting, denominator and CLI limits were exercised with isolated synthetic fixtures.
Status reporting without --export reads receipts; --export verifies completed output hashes and retains partial failures separately.
Hash identity binds reviewed sources; later edits require re-review before continuation.
This acceptance covers orchestration and bookkeeping only; model assumptions, missing original empirical data, unknown source uncertainty and whole-dissertation incompleteness remain.
